exit_messages.1: MySQL Workbench could not open or fill the connection window. Close any open connection dialogs and retry.
exit_messages.2: Enable JumpServer in macOS Privacy & Security → Accessibility, then retry.
exit_messages.3: Invalid database connection or unsupported MySQL Workbench application bundle.
exit_messages.4: Complete the initial setup in MySQL Workbench or install the database driver if prompted, then retry.
exit_messages.5: Quit MySQL Workbench and retry from JumpServer to enable accessible connection controls.
exit_messages.7: Another database autofill is in progress. Retry after it finishes.
